title: Trust Accounting Memo — Figuring the Excess on an Overpaid Bed-Hold Charge
content:
For a Resident Trust Fund Accounts account, the return for a bed-hold overcharge is figured on one transfer and one charge. The transfer returned is the most recent transfer to a bed-hold charge (of two on the same date, the one recorded first), and the charge it named, on the resident's reservation under Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations, is the charge the return is figured on.

## The computation, in order

1. **Nights due**: the charge's nights from the hold's first chargeable night through the hold's last held day.
2. **Amount due**: each night due at the nightly rate due for that night, or the charge itself where a bed-hold charge agreement prices the charge (below).
3. **Excess**: the charge less the amount due, never below zero.
4. **Transfer's portion**: the whole excess.
5. **Return**: the transfer's portion, never more than the transfer and never below zero, rounded half up to the cent once, on the final amount only.

## Charges a bed-hold charge agreement prices

Where a bed-hold charge agreement prices the charge — the single resident-private entry of a Private Pay Hospital Leave hold whose leave has ended; the opening entry of a Medicaid Hospital Leave Reserved Bed hold carrying more than one resident-private entry, or its closing entry once the leave has ended; the opening or the closing entry of a released Private Pay Therapeutic Leave hold carrying more than one resident-private entry — the hold's own rules are that agreement, whose priced figure is the charge posted on the entry, so the amount due is the charge itself and there is no excess. A leave has ended once the reservation shows the hold returned, released or expired.

## Definitions

- **First chargeable night**: the latest of the charge's first night, the first night the notice rule allows and the private hold start date the bed-hold office recorded on the reservation, because a later election holds the bed only from the day of election. The notice rule allows every night the charge bills, so the first night it allows is the charge's first night.
- **Last held day**: the end date recorded on the reservation where it falls inside the charge's nights, because a returned, released or expired hold records its last held day as its end date; otherwise the charge's last night.
- **Nightly rate due**: the private daily rate that the rate schedule in effect sets for the room tier priced; where no room tier can be priced, the charge's own daily rate. Every night is priced at the schedule in effect on the date the charge was billed: the schedule taking effect 2026-07-01 for a charge billed on or after that date, and the schedule taking effect 2025-07-01 for a charge billed from 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30. A charge billed before 2025-07-01, before either schedule this policy prices, keeps the charge's own daily rate.
- **Room tier priced**: the room tier of the resident's Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency agreement.

## Private daily rates by schedule

| Room tier | Schedule taking effect 2025-07-01 | Schedule taking effect 2026-07-01 |
|---|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | $384.00 | $398.00 |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | $412.00 | $427.00 |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | $421.00 | $436.00 |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | $449.00 | $465.00 |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | $466.00 | $482.00 |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | $497.00 | $514.00 |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A Medicare Skilled Stay Hospital Leave Bed Hold charge billed 3 March 2026 covers 5 nights from 24 February 2026 at $421.00 a night, $2105.00 in all, and a transfer of $2105.00 paid it. The reservation records a private hold start date of 26 February and an end date of 27 February; the resident's agreement is for a Private Long-Term Care Room.

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| first chargeable night | 26 February |
| last held day | 27 February |
| nights due | 2 (26 and 27 February) |
| nightly rate due (2025-07-01 schedule, the charge billed 3 March 2026) | $421.00 |
| amount due | $842.00 |
| excess: $2105.00 less $842.00 | $1263.00 |
| return | **$1263.00** |
